card.name: Digits inside enzyme and receptor names
card.fires_on: The character just before a final number in a drug-target name, such as the 1 in P2Y1 2 inhibitor or IID before 6 in P450 IID6. It also fires on a stray symbol after a gene name.

modes.label: P2Y12 split
modes.description: The 1 in P2Y12 when the name is split into pieces, before an inhibitor.
modes.example: Do not administer ticagrelor tablets with another oral P2Y <<1>>2 platelet inhibitor.

modes.label: CYP2D6 naming
modes.description: The IID piece in P450 IID6 enzyme names.
modes.example: Caution must be exercised whenever quinidine is prescribed together with drugs metabolized by cytochrome P450<< IID>>6 .

modes.label: Gene or dose symbols
modes.description: A lone letter or symbol after a gene name or dose figure.
